sidebar.expanded: w-64 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border-r border-slate-800 transition-all duration-300 z-20 shrink-0
sidebar.collapsed: w-16 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border-r border-slate-800 transition-all duration-300 z-20 shrink-0 items-center
sidebar.grouping_strategy: Use section headers (OVERVIEW, FIELD, ADMIN) with text-xs tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-500 mt-6 mb-2 px-4. When collapsed, hide headers or show a thin horizontal divider.

layouts.main_content: flex-1 overflow-auto flex flex-col relative bg-slate-50
layouts.content_container: p-6 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full flex-1 flex flex-col gap-6

buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2

data_tables.header_row: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.shadows: Keep shadows very minimal and crisp (e.g., shadow-sm). Rely on 1px borders (border-slate-200) to separate elements rather than large drop shadows, mimicking dense corporate SaaS.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-md for buttons/inputs, rounded-lg for cards/tables.

construction_banners.description: Construction workers review plans at a job site

accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add descriptive, role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, buttons, links, inputs, and major containers (e.g., 'sidebar-nav-item', 'topbar-search-input', 'roi-metric-card').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio. The navy sidebar (#0F172A) with white text provides excellent contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent.1_layout_structure: Build a responsive App Shell. Sidebar on the left (navy bg), Top Bar on the top (white bg, global search, user avatar). Main content area occupies remaining space. Sidebar must include a toggle button (e.g. at the bottom or top right of sidebar) to collapse between w-64 and w-16. Use React state to manage this collapse.
instructions_to_main_agent.2_sidebar_navigation: Group sidebar links into exactly these sections: OVERVIEW (Dashboard, Live Feed), FIELD (Tasks, Field View), ADMIN (Jobs, Settings). Show uppercase small group headers when expanded. Hide group headers and just show icons when collapsed.
instructions_to_main_agent.3_dashboard: The Dashboard must feature an 'ROI hero metric' card prominently at the top. Followed by a grid of smaller KPI tiles. Below that, implement charts using 'recharts' and a 'Foreman Leaderboard' table.
instructions_to_main_agent.4_field_view: Create a mobile-friendly view mimicking the field app. Use dense task lists with status pills. Simulate a 'Validation Checklist' sheet/modal and a 'Photo Capture' placeholder.
instructions_to_main_agent.5_admin_panels: Build Super Admin panels with dense data tables. Jobs CRUD, Tasks CRUD with checkboxes for multi-select bulk re-categorize, 'Common Mistakes' list, and a Danger Zone for resets.
instructions_to_main_agent.6_csv_importer: Build a CSV/Excel importer modal with a full de-selectable task preview table (dense rows, checkboxes on the left).
instructions_to_main_agent.7_fonts_and_styling: Completely remove Barlow Condensed and the #FF5F15 orange / #CCFF00 yellow dark theme. Apply the new Corporate SaaS palette (Light background, Navy sidebar, Blue accents). Import Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text to achieve the clean SaaS look. Use standard .js files for React components (NOT .tsx).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, focus rings.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable inside layouts, but keep data tables dense as requested.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
Do not use transparent backgrounds over content; use solid whites (bg-white) or greys (bg-slate-50) in light mode.
